description: Live wiring for Maintenance Bay (the 3rd of the 5 canonical unified product surfaces to get real data, after Learning Studio rung 7 and the Repo Clinic live-diagnosis wiring). MaintenanceBayPanel.tsx previously only fetched a static get_maintenance_bay_workflow_state capability descriptor -- every prop defaulted false/unknown regardless of reality, identical to Repo Clinic's state before its fix. This rung is WIRING, not invention: scripts/security/security_gate.py already existed, already composed 5 real scanners (secret_scan, dependency_scan via pip-audit, verify_lockfiles, license_scan, container_scan) into one pass/fail result, and had a real prior run on record (assurance/security/dependency_scan.json, 2026-07-02). A fresh live run during this rung found 353 packages / 110 high-severity CVEs and 1 flagged license -- the first time this scanner's real findings were ever surfaced anywhere in the product UI. New command run_maintenance_bay_scan wired end-to-end: backend_command_surface.py -> _tauri_driver.py -> ide_repair_bridge.rs #[tauri::command] -> lib.rs generate_handler! -> MaintenanceBayPanel.tsx (new 'Run Live Scan' button, explicit opt-in -- NOT auto-fetched on mount, since a real pip-audit pass over the whole environment can take several seconds). Deliberately excluded from UNIFIED_PRODUCT_READ_ONLY_COMMANDS (Python + Rust), same reasoning as generate_learning_studio_content: real per-call computation, not a static view-model snapshot. Later-stage props (approvalPresent, postApplyVerifierPassed, rollbackPlanPresent) remain honestly false by default -- no update-application session-state exists yet, same as Repo Clinic's later stages.
purpose: Live security/maintenance advisory for Maintenance Bay, composed from the 5 existing scripts/security/*.py scanners -- never fabricated, never silently passing.

scope_discipline.subprocess_spawned_note: the 5 pre-existing security scanners shell out (pip-audit, git log for secret_scan); no new subprocess surface was introduced by this rung
